title: M/S Silverton Papers Limited v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. And Others
coram: Amitava Lala and Ashok Srivastava, JJ.
disposition: Interim continued on non-cash security; counter directed; connected.
headnote: On a challenge to additional security, the Court observed that section 47 of the Electricity Act, 2003 is to be read with clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, directed a counter-affidavit, and continued the interim order granted in similar pending writs subject to furnishing security other than cash and bank guarantee, connecting the petition with Writ-C No. 9849 of 2011.
facts: Silverton Papers Limited challenged additional security demanded by Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. Counsel for the corporation stated that about five hundred similar writs were pending with interim orders. The petitioner argued that a pre-paid scheme would dispense with additional security; the respondents said no pre-paid metre was available in the State. The Court called for affidavits, continued the interim order granted in earlier additional-security writs, and connected the petition with Writ-C No. 9849 of 2011.

holding_units.holding: Section 47 of the Electricity Act, 2003 is to be read with clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 in connection with security and additional security. Pending that additional-security challenge, the form of interim order granted in similar pending writs continues subject to the consumer furnishing security, other than cash and bank guarantee, to the satisfaction of the licensee.

not_decided.point: Whether a pre-paid metering scheme dispenses with additional security
not_decided.note: Petitioner so contended; respondents stated no pre-paid metre was available in the State. The Court did not decide the point.
Counter-affidavit directed; petition connected and listed with Writ-C No. 9849 of 2011.
